abilities.summary: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn. The SRD feature offers additional movement when Focus is spent.

abilities.title: Stunning Strike
abilities.meta: Once per turn after a hit • Spend 1 Focus Point
abilities.summary: Force the target to make a Constitution save. On a failure, it has the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.

game_level_1.system_upgrade: Apply the starting curated D&D level 5-equivalent Monk package.

game_level_2.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 9-equivalent Monk package; limited-power uses become 2.

game_level_3.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 13-equivalent Monk package; limited-power uses become 3.

game_level_4.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 17-equivalent Monk package, including a major class-feature, combat-stat, armor/resource, and existing-power upgrade; limited-power uses become 4.

game_level_5.system_upgrade: Jump directly to the curated D&D level 20-equivalent Monk capstone package; limited-power uses become 5 and no further in-session levels are allowed.
